get.description:
Return a list of organizations available to the authenticated session in a region.
This is particularly useful for requests with a user bound context. For API key-based requests this will only return the organization that belongs to the key.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Specify `true` to restrict results to organizations in which you are an owner.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
Filters results by using [query syntax](/product/sentry-basics/search/).

Valid query fields include:
- `id`: The organization ID
- `slug`: The organization slug
- `status`: The organization's current status (one of `active`, `pending_deletion`, or `deletion_in_progress`)
- `email` or `member_id`: Filter your organizations by the emails or [organization member IDs](/api/organizations/list-an-organizations-members/) of specific members included
- `query`: Filter your organizations by name, slug, and members that contain this substring

Example: `query=(slug:foo AND status:active) OR (email:[thing-one@example.com,thing-two@example.com] AND query:bar)`

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description:
The field to sort results by, in descending order. If not specified the results are sorted by the date they were created.

Valid fields include:
- `members`: By number of members
- `events`: By number of events in the past 24 hours

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Limit the number of rows to return in the result. Default and maximum allowed is 100.

get.description: Return a list of issues for an organization. All parameters are supplied as query string parameters. A default query of `is:unresolved` is applied. To return all results, use an empty query value (i.e. ``?query=`).

parameters.name: organization_id_or_slug
parameters.description: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: The name of environments to filter by.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description:
The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects.
For example, the following are valid parameters:
- `/?project=1234&project=56789`
- `/?project=android&project=javascript-react`
- `/?project=-1`

parameters.name: statsPeriod
parameters.description:
The period of time for the query, will override the start & end parameters, a number followed by one of:
- `d` for days
- `h` for hours
- `m` for minutes
- `s` for seconds
- `w` for weeks

For example, `24h`, to mean query data starting from 24 hours ago to now.

parameters.name: statsPeriodStart
parameters.description: How long ago the query period starts, in the same format as `statsPeriod`. Must be sent with `statsPeriodEnd`, and is ignored when `statsPeriod` is sent.

parameters.name: statsPeriodEnd
parameters.description: How long ago the query period ends, in the same format as `statsPeriod`. Must be sent with `statsPeriodStart`, and is ignored when `statsPeriod` is sent.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The start of the period of time for the query, expected in ISO-8601 format. For example, `2001-12-14T12:34:56.7890`.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The end of the period of time for the query, expected in ISO-8601 format. For example, `2001-12-14T12:34:56.7890`.

parameters.name: groupStatsPeriod
parameters.description: The timeline on which stats for the groups should be presented.

parameters.name: shortIdLookup
parameters.description: If this is set to `1` then the query will be parsed for issue short IDs. These may ignore other filters (e.g. projects), which is why it is an opt-in.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: An optional search query for filtering issues. A default query will apply if no query is set. For all results use this parameter with an empty string.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The sort order of the view. Options include 'Last Seen' (`date`), 'First Seen' (`new`), 'Trends' (`trends`), 'Events' (`freq`), 'Users' (`user`), 'Date Added' (`inbox`), and 'Recommended' (`recommended`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of issues to return. The maximum is 100.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Additional data to include in the response.

parameters.name: collapse
parameters.description: Fields to remove from the response to improve query performance.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.
